biotools.summary: A web server for interpretable protein function analysis and custom model training using protein language models

function.cmd:
python protsv.py train esm2 --model-path <model pathway> --positive-gz <positive dataset pathway> --proteome-negative-gz <negative dataset pathway>  --pos-neg-ratio <1.0> --threshold <0.5> 
python protsv.py predict --model-path <model pathway> --model_pkl <pkl_pathway> --scaler_pkl <scaler_pkl> --fasta_file <fasta> --threshold<0.5>

biotools.name: ProtSV
